reviewer: independent review executor (QoderCN agent session e58b828003f28f0fd371bf461e820d18, agent c2283260c5da99a5d2076c04); not the author of the engine under review; host Windows 11 / Git Bash, git 2.46.0.windows.1, rustc 1.89.0 used only for standalone std-only repro probes

scope_details.task_summary: M0/M1 slices of the gateway file service: contract-first PRODUCT/MODULE/requirements + 9 frozen E4 scenarios + the engine (file_service.rs) + the E4 probe (gateway_file_contract.rs)

not_verified_by_reviewer: nexus-web-gateway cannot compile on the reviewer host (ssh2 0.9.6 userauth_pubkey_memory is gated by cfg(any(unix, vendored-openssl, openssl-on-win32)) and there is no cl.exe/nasm), so engine behaviour claims other than the standalone probes below are static reading, not crate-compiled. Items with executed evidence: gate selection (item 7 ran the real pre-commit snippet against the real .evidence tree), SendBudget/FileLimits::validate arithmetic and the resolve loop (recompiled as std-only probes in a temp dir).

blocking_issues.summary: SendBudget and FileSession.inflight_bytes are never wired into FileEngine; the probe hand-rolls its own SendBudget, so quota-backpressure proves an offline model rather than the product path. G16/PRODUCT 18.2/REQ-011 send-side backpressure is unimplemented in the engine.

drain_file_reserve returns usize::from(freed > 0): squeezing out N file messages is recorded as 1. Reproduced by recompiled probe (limit=100, ten 10-byte file messages, one 40-byte terminal -> 4 messages evicted, file_drops += 1).

mutation_capability_of_sftp_backend reads the enum predicate back into JSON; flipping BackendKind::Sftp::allows_mutation() changes implementation and assertion together, so the scenario can never go red.

SandboxRoot::resolve breaks on NotFound, so a/b/c truncates to a. Measured in a recompiled probe. An upload whose parent chain does not exist therefore publishes to the wrong prefix and reports success, violating the fixed-output identity of N3-4:16 / N3-9:9 (G18, PRODUCT 18.1).

The window between reverify_parent and create_new(part) (and between reverify_parent and hard_link) is neither defended nor declared: std-only has no O_NOFOLLOW, so a parent directory swapped for an escaping symlink writes .part bytes outside the root and abort_upload then deletes through that link outside the root. The probe only exercises the commit-time swap.

The Review Evidence gate selects .evidence/review-* by sort|tail -1 and reads only the verdict, so an unrelated case (review-g11-ice-fix-qoder-r1, source_revision 0576cb7) passed a change to file_service.rs. Executed against the real tree: GATE DECISION: PASS. Additionally /.evidence is gitignored, so new cases do not travel with the branch unless force-added.

blocking_issues_remaining: G1 (fixed on branch fix/hook-review-evidence-binding at 689f63a; not merged into master nor into this feature branch, so the gate on this branch is still the unbound one)
non_blocking_suggestions: W1 validate() has no ack-bytes term (max_entries_per_page x name length vs max_ack_bytes) and the sessions x inflight <= buffered x 64 factor admits 32-64x over-budget; measured 4MiB worst vs 8MiB threshold passing at a real 32x over-allocation
W2 ssh.max_terminals has only a lower bound (config.rs:73/255) and lives in a different struct from FileLimits, so the terminal face never enters the same resource equation as the file face
W3 stage_chunk acks bytes that were only flush()ed (a std no-op); PRODUCT 18.1/G18 wording said durably staged
W4 commit with expected_sha256=None and declared_len=None publishes without any verification, while G18 promises digest+length before publish
W5 max_rehash_bytes_per_stream is used as a verification gate, so an artifact larger than the budget can never be digest-published (capability cliff)
W6 two unit tests have no kill power (every_verb_is_audited_including_refusals stays green if a record call is deleted; constant_time_eq_... stays green with an early return)
W7 throttle_entries_bounded reads buckets.len() only, not the locked table nor RSS
peak_read_handles_within_budget is an in-process registry counter, not an OS fd count; the ~1022-fd DoS that G16 names is not observed (needs /proc/self/fd on Linux)
MODULE.md self-reports a unit-test count (12) and the probe header said eight cases while dispatching nine
